messages:
Elaine: Thanks everyone — quick thread to capture outstanding Qs from today’s all‑hands about sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partnerships. Drop follow-ups and we’ll route to the right owners.

Katie: Could you confirm the FY26 ARR target again and which verticals we should prioritize for new AE hires?

Elaine: FY26 company ARR target is $150M. Priorities for new headcount: fintech and developer platforms in NA, healthcare pilot in EU. We want 60% of new AEs focused on inbound motion.

Raj: Add to that — platform integrations are the leverage play. Partner-led motions should be prioritized where we can get co-sell credits within 3 months. APAC is long lead; prioritize partner SIs for Q4. :rocket:

Tomas: For partnerships — timeline for co-sell enablement? We need clear onboarding docs and a partner-friendly pricing SKU.

Maria: Working with product to produce a "partner SKU" that bundles Dedicated discounts + SSO. ETA end of month. Will post draft in this thread when ready.

Sofia: On pricing — can we get more detail on the discount tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted? This is showing up in deals (legal asks).

Marco: Short answer: Hosted gets 0–15% volume discounts, Dedicated has structured tiers (5%, 12%, 20%) based on committed GPU hours. Legal and Finance to finalize contract clauses next week.

Katie: Useful. Also — what's the play for small-mid ISVs who want fast proofs-of-concept? Do we push Hosted or a trial Dedicated?

Raj: Push Hosted for speed + free credits. If they need predictable throughput and data isolation, propose a short Dedicated pilot with 3-month commit. Sales ops to have a trial checklist.

Tomas: Re: partners — I’ll schedule a partner kickoff for the top 5 SI candidates and share invites. Can product and sales ops join?

Maria: Yes, I’ll join. Also will share the partner onboarding doc (early draft) here once DocsBot publishes.

DocsBot: New doc published — g2m-playbook-v0.9 (private): https://redwood.docs.internal/g2m-playbook-v0.9

Sofia: Thanks — can someone call out the single page TL;DR for quota owners? Need something 1‑pager to hand to VPs.

Elaine: Action items: 1) Maria to post partner SKU draft by EOM; 2) Marco & Finance to finalize Dedicated discount language by next Wed; 3) Tomas to run partner kickoff for top 5 SI prospects; 4) Katie to produce a 1‑pager quota/hand-off for VPs. I’ll convert to Asana tasks and tag owners.

Katie: Will do — tagging @Elaine to confirm timing for the 1‑pager review.

Raj: Quick ask for leadership — please surface any risky customer commitments in this thread before EOD Friday so we can assess capacity.

Elaine: Noted. Thanks everyone — will follow up with a summary and Asana links. :thumbsup:
